title: Live capture & replay harness for multi-tenant stream migration and structured-output validation
creator: Diego Marquez
description:
Problem: We have recurrent regressions when migrating live streaming workloads between model variants and runtimes. Existing unit-style contract tests catch schema mismatches but fail to reproduce timing interleavings and partial-JSON emissions that break downstream tool call parsers in production. This ticket designs and implements a capture-and-replay harness that records real multi-tenant streaming sessions (prefixes, interleaving order, partial chunks, connection resets) and replays them deterministically against candidate runtime/model variants to detect regressions in: structured-output fidelity, function/tool calling order, stream chunk boundaries, and graceful fallback behavior.

Goals: 
- Capture anonymized live stream sessions with metadata (tenant id, route, model version, latency buckets) and safe-sanitization policies.
- Reproduce the exact chunking/interleaving patterns plus simulated network events (packet drops, slow clients, mid-stream reconnects).
- Validate outputs against contract assertions: JSON round-trip, presence/ordering of function call begin/end markers, KV-cache priming signatures, and golden-seed behavioral fingerprints.
- Integrate harness into CI as a nightly regression job that fails the candidate runtime build if a contract assertion is violated or if a behavioral fingerprint divergence exceeds thresholds.
- Provide dashboards with diff visualizations and a ranked list of suspect commits/PRs responsible for regression candidates.

Design notes: 
- Capture format: newline-delimited event log with base64-encoded partial-chunk payloads, sequence ids, and vectorized timing deltas. Stored in S3 with lifecycle policies. See design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RT/Stream+Capture+Format.
- Replay engine: deterministic scheduler that can inject delays, reorderings, and simulated failures. Runs in a sandboxed runner that can target hosted, dedicated, or private deployments using the same API tokens but stubbed billing.
- Validators: a pluggable set of validators. Initial validators: json-closure (ensures incremental JSON can be assembled), functioncall-order (asserts that tool calls occur at expected boundaries), schema-compat (JSON Schema overlays), and behavior-fingerprint (hash of normalized token-stream and structural events).
- Privacy & compliance: capture must redact PII and user prompts according to policy. We will include an allowlist/denylist and a differential-sampling agent to avoid storing sensitive content. Security review required (see security_review_required).

Exit criteria: 
- Harness captures > 1000 anonymized sessions across 3 tenants and can replay 95% of them deterministically.
- CI job integrated into nightly pipeline with alerting to #runtime-regressions and an on-call rotation.
- First regression triage run demonstrates reproducible failure and links to a PR fix.

comments: 2025-02-11 Diego Marquez: Spike complete — captured 150 sessions from prod-proxy in anonymized mode. Found 3 cases where partial JSON chunks caused function-call parser to mis-associate args. Added sample captures to S3 (s3://redwood-test-streams/eng-39210/).

2025-02-13 Aisha Patel: Implemented deterministic scheduler prototype that can replay chunk timing deltas and inject TCP-level resets. Scheduler unit tests included. Opened PR #14 against stream-replay-prober.
2025-02-14 Naoko Sato (security): Reviewed capture format. Requested PII redaction by default and an opt-in tenant flag. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-02-16 Rahul Singh (runtime): Found two edgecases when replaying against quantized model variant q-mix-1 — KV-cache priming differs due to attention-ordering micro-ops. Added cache-priming-normalizer to validators. See issue ENG-39301 (dependency).

2025-02-18 PM review (Marco Nguyen): Agreed to prioritize CI integration and nightly runs before broad dashboard rollout. Suggested alerting threshold of >3 failing golden-seed regressions to trigger pager. Added 'nightly-ci' label.

2025-02-19 Aisha Patel: Integrated replay job into CircleCI nightly workflow (workflow: nightly-stream-replay). First run flagged 1 failure against runtime-1.18 candidate; created follow-up PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/512 with fix for chunk-assembler off-by-one.
notes: This harness intentionally targets multi-tenant failure modes that are hard to catch with unit tests. Expect a one-week stabilization period as we tune validators and thresholds. Prioritize low false-positive rate to avoid CI noise.
